name: Prayers Of The Unrighteous
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the prayers of the unrighteous are not heard by God because sin and iniquity create a separation between the sinner and the Lord. When a person harbors sin in their heart or turns away from God's law, their prayers become an abomination and are rejected, as seen in Psalms 66:18 and Proverbs 28:9. Conversely, God is near to the righteous and hears their prayers, especially when they abide in Christ and His words abide in them, promising answered prayer according to John 15:7.
